messages:
mira: Heads-up — customer reported that after last week's RBAC refactor their on-prem 'ops-admin' role can no longer access control-plane audit logs. They see a 403 during KMS decrypt. Any ideas?

jay: That's the refactor where we split the old 'admin' umbrella into onprem_admin + platform_admin, right? Could be the svcacct mapping changed and the KMS IAM wasn't updated.

sam: Can you paste the exact error and any headers you have?

mira: Error payload: ```{\"code\":403,\"message\":\"Access denied: kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt for projects/acme/locations/global/keyRings/ctrlplane/cryptoKeys/audit-key\"}``` Header I see: x-customer-vpc-ip=10.1.7.12 and x-customer-id=acme-inc

irene: That stack makes sense — the control plane uses a service account to call KMS. During the role split we changed which svcacct the onprem controller runs as (svc-onprem@... -> svc-controlplane@...). If the customer's KMS key only grants access to the old svcacct, decrypts will fail.

mira: I checked the customer's KMS bindings: they only list svc-onprem@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Our new mapping uses svc-controlplane-prod@..., so it fails. I thought the allowlist-sync job would update KMS bindings when role mappings change, but looks like it didn't.

jay: The allowlist syncer lives in pkg/allowlist/syncer.go — the refactor changed the identity enum and I think we missed one switch-case to include the new svcacct; I'll open a PR. Short-term mitigation is to add the old svcacct back to the customer's KMS key (ops-assisted) so they're unblocked.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: patch/rbac/allowlist-sync-fix — CI passed, staging deploy successful. :rocket:

sam: Also propose we add a reconciliation check in the rollout pipeline: whenever role mappings change, run a KMS-binding diff for any affected customers and fail the rollout if discrepancies exist. Otherwise this will recur.

audit-bot: Created alert rule: rbac-kms-binding-drift and runbook stub: when a role_mapping_change event occurs, run kms_reconcile job and emit a finding to sec-audit.

mira: Filed an internal incident SEC-429 with timeline and customer impact: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-429 — adding triage notes and immediate mitigation steps.

irene: Additional note: on-prem control plane manifests sometimes include hardcoded svcacct annotations for legacy installs. We should add a migration step that maps legacy annotations to new identities and record that in the private-deploy upgrade doc.

jay: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3142 — small change in syncer: add new identity case + unit tests.

sam: I'll add a unit test that simulates role_mapping updates and verifies kms_policy reconciliation runs. Also adding a golden integration test for a fake KMS with both identities.

mira: Ops applied the temporary KMS binding for the customer, they report logs are flowing again. I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours and then remove the emergency binding once reconciliation is in place.

jay: Working on getting the fix merged and deployed to prod later today.

audit-bot: Audit entry logged: {event:\"role_mapping_change\", customer:\"acme-inc\", changed_by:\"mira\", ticket:\"SEC-429\"} (search id: audit-2026-03-20-782)

mira: Thanks all — plan: (1) emergency KMS binding (done), (2) merge syncer fix (jay), (3) add reconciliation + gating (sam), (4) add migration note for private upgrades (irene), (5) postmortem in 48h. I'll update SEC-429 with owners and ETA.
